prompt: readEvents in src/read-events.js parses a JSONL event log, but it silently drops every legacy record written before the schema_version field existed, and one malformed line aborts the whole read. Fix it so that (1) a record with no schema_version is normalized to schema_version 0 rather than dropped, and its event_type is inferred as 'injection' when it has an injected_tokens field and 'outcome' when it has an outcome field; (2) a legacy record matching neither shape is counted as unrecognized, not dropped silently; (3) a line that is not valid JSON, or that parses to something other than a plain object, is counted as corrupt and skipped without throwing; (4) blank and whitespace-only lines are ignored entirely and counted nowhere; (5) the function returns {events, skipped} where skipped is {corrupt, unrecognized}, and events preserves input order. Run `node test/read-events.test.js` to check your work.
success_criteria: Legacy records without schema_version are retained and normalized
Legacy event_type is inferred from the record shape
Unrecognized legacy records are counted rather than dropped silently
A corrupt line is skipped and counted without aborting the read
Blank lines are ignored and counted nowhere
